tagline: 柯达便携相机，2000 年发布
description: 柯达于2000年推出的便携相机。配备Kodak Ektanar 1:5.6/25mm (3 glass elements)。快门速度speeds 1/90 - 1/250 sec.。使用APS film cartridges with speeds 50 to 800 ASA。Autofocus。

specs.胶片/画幅: APS film cartridges with speeds 50 to 800 ASA
specs.取景器: reverse galilean, framed like chosen image format
specs.闪光灯: built into flip-up lens cover, reaching as far as 4 meters with 200 ASA film
